claims.explanation: Halcinonide is a glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) agonist, and its selective antiproliferative pattern across cancer lines is most plausibly driven by NR3C1 expression and intact glucocorticoid signaling: lines with high NR3C1 and glucocorticoid-responsive transcriptional programs (e.g., TSC22D3 induction) are sensitized, while lines with low NR3C1 or glucocorticoid resistance mechanisms are protected. The virtual-cell signature (TSC22D3 up-regulation and similarity to other GR agonists) confirms on-target GR engagement, so selectivity should track GR pathway competence rather than a single lineage.
